column1: # manifests/singularity-payload.tsv -- reviewed PREBUILT Singularity Desktop
# payload .deb pins.  One row per arch:
#   <arch>\t<sha256>\t<version>
# The sha256 (field 2) is read by build/gen-base-pin.sh and emitted as
# singularity_payload_sha256_<arch> in manifests/determinism.pin; it seeds the
# "hotfix" layer fingerprint (build/lib/layerplan.py).  The image layers stage
# consumes exactly these bytes via NCZ_SINGULARITY_PREBUILT_DEB /
# NCZ_SINGULARITY_PREBUILT_SHA256 (build/layers-preflight.sh check_frozen_deb).
# The .deb version is a timestamped `YYYYMMDDhhmmss+bk0+tgz<hash>` string, so it
# cannot be statically pinned in manifests/ncz-packages.tsv (see the header of
# manifests/ncz-timestamped.tsv); the reviewed-ledger row for the timestamped
# form lives there, and this file records the concrete 26.10 build.
# Final rows are locally staged; publication to Buildkite/R2 is pending.
# The 26.10 payload carries the singularity-shell queue 0015-0020
# (lock-over-saver overlay, no-prompt-before-input, freeze/HOLD on input,
# login-card parity, a second lock instance yields instead of taking the
# renderer socket, frame source backoff kept across handshakes and no source
# without an output) and the greeter/loginui parity patches (greeter 0003,
# loginui 0003).
# 20261013150000 is built from the 2026-10-13 upstream heads (superproject
# 6d6bbc7f: Messages, SIT, liquid glass) with the same patch queue; the arm64
# deb Depends on libgtk4-layer-shell0 (>= 1.3.0-1+ncz20261013)
# (build/singularity-depends-floors.tsv).
# 20261013233000 is built from the same upstream commits with the full queue:
# shell 0021 (overview clear of the dock), 0022 (logind Lock and
# PrepareForSleep), 0023 (saver resumes when the prompt lowers), leafs 0001
# (window buttons with the classic titlebar) and nearby 0001+0002 (links are
# freed when they close; an open link is kept when the peer announces itself).
# 20261017070524 is built from the 2026-10-17 upstream heads (superproject
# 45c6e8e8, shell a65e9c34, libsingularity 8cb3e804, greeter 09007fda,
# nearby c17a12a4, plugins 6d989ea5, leafs 143fc0f9, labwc 458dddc5), the
# greeter 0003 patch refreshed onto 09007fda, and the same queue otherwise.
# Native rebuilds on HYDRA (amd64) and ULTRA (arm64) at shared build
# timestamp 20261017070524, branch fix/p3-singularity-head-20261017.
# libsingularity moved cbf3d7e1 -> 8cb3e804 between these pins, yet the
# built library is byte-identical across both payloads -- verified
# 2026-10-17 by expanding both debs and hashing opt/singularity/lib:
# amd64 libsingularity.so.0 b07dce55c3cd... and
# libsingularity-system.so.0 4e56dbca3b64...; arm64 8881de20447e... and
# cb9c9b0f8a3f..., with identical top-level lib listings. The commit move
# carried no ABI-affecting change, so the ncz-screensavers-plugin 0.3.23
# pin (post-install/lib/ncz-screensavers-plugin.lock) stays valid under
# the ABI gate without a plugin rebuild.
# 20261014180000 is built from the 2026-10-14 upstream heads (shell 5430ce14,
# libsingularity cbf3d7e1, plugins 869d2afc, nearby 6b507295, session 2a1f4331,
# superproject 13b79e78) after the upstream merge of the 2026-10-13 pull requests.
# Queue: shell 0003 0005 0013-0023, libsingularity 0002-0004, plugins 0002 0004 0007,
# leafs 0001, nearby 0002, greeter/loginui/session/write unchanged. Shell 0002 0004
# 0006, desktop 0001 0002, plugins 0001 0003 0005 0006 and nearby 0001 merged upstream.
# Final native builds: shared timestamp 20261014213143, actual builder source
# 291821e21f168e5f980d9b2f4954fea62594a20a, with shell 0024 (pause/resume and
# the 60-second prompt limit). Both installed payloads pass the 74-case lock
# assertions and independent process cleanup audit; image/hardware gates remain.
